text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's all for training today, right? In
that case—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you are, Ayabe! I'm stealing
you and
your trainer away! Come with
me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you came, Curren. Your sudden
message
surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, the next customer's Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Perfect tim'n! If you have any
hair-related
questions, City's the one
t'ask!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to City's hair salon! ♪ She's
gotten
really popular since she matches
her business
hours to your schedule!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. You should hear this.
Yesterday,
Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My hair keeps getting in the way. Maybe
I should cut
it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my scissors broke. Now I've gotta
buy some new
ones.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe Ayabe just cuts that
pretty hair
of hers herself?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, to each their own, I suppose. But if
you let
me help, I promise you won't be
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe! Just like with a leg injury, it's
waaay better
to get treated by someone
who knows what
they're doing!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But I take care of my legs myself too.
Anyway, if
this isn't related to racing, I'm
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Yukino! Proper hair care can
benefit
your running too, right? Like,
making it easier to
run or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Righty-roo! If you get City to treat your
hair, it'll
become so sleek 'n smooth that
even with the
wind blow'n 'round and
'round, your hair'll stay
outta your face!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(She's right. Changing the style might
decrease
some wind resistance...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All of her customers are top-class
Umamusume.
Even Hishiama is a patron!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You know what that means?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to lose by just trying!
Isn't that
right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to lose by just trying!
Isn't that
right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You heard 'em! This way, Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then. So, any idea what you'd like
me to do
with your hair?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Whatever helps me run fast.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right! So no changes to the length, but
treat
damaged areas and reduce the
volume, am I
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's a great translation. Shall we
get to
it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer... What was my time?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I should've known you'd go
running right
after getting your hair
done all nice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I only went along because you said it
would help
me in racing. What else
would I do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You'll never change...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Admire Vega puts more
effort into
grooming her hair and tail,
and she grows brighter
and brighter
each day.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I understand...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! ♪ Now that you're on board, we
should
try all kinds of things!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All kinds of things?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
First a cut, and then shampoo, and then

treatment...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I can give her a head massage as well.
Nothing
good comes from having a tight
scalp. I could
help you loosen up if you
want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whatever's bothering you, just let me
know, and I
can even recommend you
another salon that
specializes in that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't need that much...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get started? ♪ Let's head over
to the
washing station!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-hold on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Admire Vega comes
back with
her hair and tail sparkling.
However...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That means the head massage worked.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's because you're such a workaholic.
You need
to take some time off to relax
once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nod... Nod...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's head droops as she
battles her
sleep. She doesn't seem the
type to ever give
herself a break. I'll
need to keep this in mind
moving
forward.
